prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 财务指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "2022 年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "2023 年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 50px
  col 4: header "2024 年" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 51px
  col 5: header "同比" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 48px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 239px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 523px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 522px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示主要财务指标在 2022—2024 年的变化，并用同比和备注补充解释。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较三年数值和同比；备注提供原因或背景。各行应保持清楚的视觉对应关系。","groups":["2022 年、2023 年、2024 年：同一指标的连续年度数值，适合采用相同或接近的列宽，便于横向比较。","同比与年度数值：都是用于判断变化的数字，应保持数值完整。","指标与备注：分别承担行标识和文字说明；指标需要易于定位，备注可利用行高换行。"],"keep_intact":["年度数值、百分比、正负号及百分比单位","指标名称中的数字、单位和括号尽量保持完整","年份表头尽量保持单行"],"may_wrap":["较长的备注可按中文语义自然换行，并与所属数据行对齐。","较长的指标名称可在自然位置换行；已有备注换行形成的行高可容纳指标换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [93, 71, 71, 71, 69, 147] · table 523×260px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [90, 71, 71, 71, 69, 150] · table 523×260px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"三年列等宽，年份表头和数值保持单行，便于横向比较；同比数值完整。备注自然换行，各行之间的对应关系清楚。","problems":"营业收入和研发投入的单位各自落到第二行；经营性现金流在名称中间断开，行标识的辨识度受到影响。第一行备注也只在末尾留下一个字。","cause":"指标列为93px，可用文字宽度为72px，容不下较长指标及其单位；备注列为147px，首行略不足以容纳完整说明。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"年度列和同比列保持了清楚的数字比较节奏，备注仍最多两行，表头全部单行。","problems":"指标名称和单位的断行与r2A相似，经营性现金流仍在名称中间断开；增加的备注宽度也没有消除第一行末尾单字。整体改进不明显。","cause":"指标列缩至90px，进一步压缩了行标识；备注列增至150px，但增加的3px不足以让第一行备注完整放在一行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"label-plus","widths":[101,71,71,71,69,139],"change":"从备注列转移8px给指标列，改善较长指标名称的断行，同时保留等宽年度列和完整同比数值；观察较窄备注是否产生难接受的第三行。"},{"name":"balanced","widths":[97,71,71,71,69,143],"change":"在指标与备注之间作较温和的调整，尝试改善指标断行，同时尽量维持备注的两行节奏。"},{"name":"labels-first","widths":[105,71,71,71,69,135],"change":"进一步优先保证行标识的可读性，检验更宽的指标列能否让名称和单位形成更自然的断行，以及备注增加的行高是否值得这一取舍。"}]}
